```{r}
#| label: eftabfunc
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false

eftabfunc <- function(colvar) {
  tab <- tmpdata %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(colvar))) %>%
    group_by(ef_cat, !!sym(colvar)) %>%
    reframe(
      med = quantile(Bili_mgdL, na.rm = T, probs = c(0.5)),
      q1 = quantile(Bili_mgdL, na.rm = T, probs = c(0.25)),
      q3 = quantile(Bili_mgdL, na.rm = T, probs = c(0.75)),
      n = n()
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      out = paste0(fn(med, 1), " [", fn(q1, 1), "-", fn(q3, 1), "]"),
      out = case_when(
        n == 0 ~ "-",
        n < 10 ~ "<10",
        TRUE ~ out
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(ef_cat) %>%
    mutate(np = if_else(n >= 10, paste0(n, " (", fn(n / sum(n) * 100), ")"), "<10")) %>%
    select(ef_cat, !!sym(colvar), np, out) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ef_cat, values_from = c(np, out)) %>%
    rename(level = !!sym(colvar)) %>%
    mutate(var = NA) %>%
    add_row(
      var = colvar,
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ef-clprof-hypoper
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| dependson: eftabfunc
#| tbl-cap: "EF and clinical profile/hypoperfusion"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

tmpdata <- bind_rows(
  escdata %>% mutate(ef_cat = "Overall"),
  escdata %>% arrange(ef_cat)
) %>%
  mutate(
    ef_cat = fct_inorder(ef_cat),
    OPCPRO_cat2 = factor(case_when(
      is.na(OPCPRO) ~ NA_real_,
      OPCPRO %in% c("Cold/Dry", "Cold/Wet") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ), levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Cold", "Warm")),
    OPBP1_cat2 = factor(case_when(
      is.na(OPBP1) ~ NA_real_,
      OPBP1 < 90 ~ 1,
      OPBP1 >= 90 ~ 0
    ), levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("<90", ">=90")),
    OPCPRO_OPBP1 = factor(case_when(
      is.na(OPCPRO_cat2) | is.na(OPBP1_cat2) ~ NA_real_,
      OPCPRO_cat2 == "Cold" & OPBP1_cat2 == "<90" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ), levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Cold and <90", "Warm or >=90")),
    ef_cat2 = factor(case_when(
      is.na(ef) ~ NA_real_,
      ef <= 20 ~ 1,
      ef > 20 ~ 0
    ), levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("<=20", ">20"))
  )

tabtmp <- lapply(c("OPCPRO_cat2", "OPBP1_cat2", "OPCPRO_OPBP1", "ef_cat2", "OPRVF", "vaso_any", "ITSTMEC"),
  FUN = eftabfunc
)

tab <- bind_rows(tabtmp) %>%
  mutate(
    # if recoding or categorizing will still get org label
    var_tmp = str_replace_all(var, "(_cat2|_cat)", "")
  )

tab <- left_join(tab,
  metaesc,
  by = c("var_tmp" = "variable")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = coalesce(label, var_tmp),
    Variable = if_else(!is.na(unit),
      paste0(Variable, " (", unit, ")"),
      Variable
    ),
    Variable = if_else(!is.na(level) & !is.na(Variable),
      paste0(Variable, " ", level),
      coalesce(Variable, paste0("  ", level))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, np_Overall, out_Overall, `np_<=40`, `out_<=40`, `np_41-49`, `out_41-49`, `np_>=50`, `out_>=50`)

cn <- c("", rep(c("N (%)", "Bilirubin (mg/dL) median [q1-q3]"), 4))

if (output) {
  make_one_xlsxsheet(tab, colnames = cn)
}

tab <- tab %>%
  mutate(
    # so no probs
    Variable = sanitize_text(Variable)
  )

indent_rows <- tab %>%
  mutate(
    indent_rows = str_detect(Variable, "  "),
    rows = row_number()
  ) %>%
  filter(indent_rows) %>%
  pull(rows)

cn <- sanitize_text(cn)

default_kable(tab,
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = cn
) %>%
  add_indent(indent_rows) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Overall" = 2, "AHF-EF (%) <=40" = 2, "AHF-EF (%) 41-49" = 2, "AHF-EF (%) >=50" = 2))
```
